description: One map layer as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection: one point per place with the reading on the date (else the latest observed before it, never a guess), or one point per event for event layers.

coops.description: NOAA CO-OPS station id(s), comma-separated, e.g. 9063085.

event.description: weather_alerts: an NWS event name, e.g. Red Flag Warning

fuel.description: power_plants: coal, oil/gas, nuclear, hydropower, wind, utility-scale solar, geothermal or bioenergy

lat.description: Ad-hoc point latitude (with lng). For weather and WSI.

radius.description: aircraft, gps_interference: nautical miles around lat/lng, 1-250

region.description: reservoirs_west: a Reclamation region, e.g. Missouri Basin

tag.description: Catalogue places with this tag, e.g. waterfowl, ice-fishing.

type.description: ships_baltic: cargo | tanker | passenger | fishing | tug | other

usgs.description: USGS monitoring location id(s), e.g. USGS-04193500.

name: get_layer
